definitions.usuarios:
CREATE TABLE `usuarios` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nome` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `senha_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `foto` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `criado_em` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `atualizado_em` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_usuarios_email` (`email`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_usuarios_nome` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`nome`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
definitions.disciplinas:
CREATE TABLE `disciplinas` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `usuario_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `nome` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `cor` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `criado_em` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_disciplinas_dono_nome` (`usuario_id`,`nome`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_disciplinas_dono_id` (`usuario_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_disciplinas_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_disciplinas_nome` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`nome`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
definitions.tarefas:
CREATE TABLE `tarefas` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `usuario_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `disciplina_id` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `titulo` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `descricao` text,
  `data_limite` datetime NOT NULL,
  `prioridade` enum('baixa','media','alta') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'media',
  `status` enum('pendente','concluida') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendente',
  `concluida_em` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `criado_em` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `atualizado_em` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_tarefas_usuario_prazo` (`usuario_id`,`data_limite`),
  KEY `ix_tarefas_disciplina` (`usuario_id`,`disciplina_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tarefas_disciplina_dono` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`, `disciplina_id`) REFERENCES `disciplinas` (`usuario_id`, `id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tarefas_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `usuarios` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_tarefas_conclusao` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'pendente') and (`concluida_em` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'concluida') and (`concluida_em` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_tarefas_titulo` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`titulo`)) > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
